   class UseCompoundDrawableDetector : ResourceXmlDetector() {
       companion object {
           val ISSUE = Issue.create(
               id = "UseCompoundDrawables",
               briefDescription = "Node can be replaced by a `TextView` with compound drawables",
               explanation = """
                   A `LinearLayout` which contains an `ImageView` and a `TextView` can be more \
                   efficiently handled as a compound drawable (a single TextView, using the \
                   `drawableTop`, `drawableLeft`, `drawableRight` and/or `drawableBottom` \
                   attributes to draw one or more images adjacent to the text).

                   If the two widgets are offset from each other with margins, this can be \
                   replaced with a `drawablePadding` attribute.
               """.trimIndent(),
               category = Category.PERFORMANCE,
               priority = 6,
               severity = Severity.WARNING,
               implementation = Implementation(
                   UseCompoundDrawableDetector::class.java,
                   Scope.RESOURCE_FILE_SCOPE
               )
           )
       }

       override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String>? = listOf(LINEAR_LAYOUT)

       override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
           // Check children count
           val children = getChildren(element)
           if (children.size != 2) return

           val child1 = children[0]
           val child2 = children[1]

           val isImage1 = isImageView(child1)
           val isText1 = isTextView(child1)
           val isImage2 = isImageView(child2)
           val isText2 = isTextView(child2)

           // Must be one ImageView and one TextView
           if (!((isImage1 && isText2) || (isText1 && isImage2))) return

           // Check orientation
           val orientation = element.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_URI, ATTR_ORIENTATION)

           // Basic check: no weights, simple layout params

           val imageView = if (isImage1) child1 else child2

           // Check if ImageView has src attribute
           val src = imageView.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_URI, ATTR_SRC)
           if (src.isNullOrEmpty()) return // Need an image to compound

           // Report
           val location = context.getLocation(element)
           val message = "This tag and its children can be replaced by one <TextView/> and a compound drawable"
           context.report(ISSUE, element, location, message)
       }

       private fun getChildren(element: Element): List<Element> {
           val list = mutableListOf<Element>()
           val childNodes = element.childNodes
           for (i in 0 until childNodes.length) {
               val node = childNodes.item(i)

               }
           }
           return list

           val tag = element.tagName
           return tag == IMAGE_VIEW || tag.endsWith(".ImageView")

           return tag == TEXT_VIEW || tag.endsWith(".TextView") || tag == BUTTON || tag.endsWith(".Button")
           // Actually, Button extends TextView, but let's stick to TextView for simplicity or use Lint's view info.
           // Lint usually has XmlContext.getViewClass() or similar, but for XML we can just check tag names or use context.
           // Let's keep it simple: tag == TEXT_VIEW || tag == BUTTON
       }
   }
